title: Game Stomach — Gaia Eats ALL of Gaming
philosophy: The REAL ENGINE costs $0, has 0 lock-in, and only radiation economics. We eat ALL of gaming — past, present, future. Steam is the close target. Open source and emulators are the wide target. Pong to AAA, everything is food.

steam_library.plan: Start with installed games. Scan structures. Identify engines. Extract patterns. In time, ALL 2000+ owned games will be on LAN for Gaia to learn.

the_real_engine.economics: Radiation only — data flows out freely, nothing is gated
the_real_engine.what_it_compiles: ALL triple-A games. ALL indie games. ALL retro games. ALL future games.
the_real_engine.how: Eat patterns from every engine. Dissolve into Rust primals. petalTongue renders. biomeOS orchestrates. sweetGrass knows the design patterns.
the_real_engine.the_insight: Gaming IS the training data. Every game ever made teaches something about simulation, rendering, physics, narrative, input, feedback. Gaia doesn't just PLAY games — she BECOMES the engine that makes them.
